runners_data.spotlight: Closest finish was a 30l defeat at Stratford (2m7f, soft; 33-1) last time in her second handicap; no recognisable claims yet.

races.paceDynamic: Paradise Park is the only confirmed front runner and will look to dictate from the off, likely joined by Half Pint Daisy and Lily Grace in a modest early pace. With just one natural leader in a 12-runner field, Paradise Park should get comfortable fractions without pressure through the early stages. The bulk of this field are hold-up horses who will need to pick their way through traffic in the straight, creating a potentially messy finish. This sustainable pace scenario strongly favours horses that can travel prominently and avoid the scramble, giving prominent runners and patient hold-up horses with tactical speed a clear edge over those needing to weave through traffic.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Paradise Park gets soft fractions and stays galloping
scenarios.body: The mare gets first run on tired legs and holds off late challenges, with the patient hold-up horses struggling to pick up the pieces in time. Her 145lbs burden becomes manageable when she's not pressed for speed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoop
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens from halfway as prominent runners press
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop stretches the field and allows the classier hold-up horses to time their runs perfectly from off the pace. Miss Kassiopi and Feet On The Ground have the tactical speed to capitalise.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic-Free Winner Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a tactical muddle with bunching
scenarios.body: One horse gets a clear passage while others are shuffled back, creating a decisive advantage for whoever finds racing room first. The jockey factor becomes crucial in this scrimmage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The handicapper's view proves overly harsh on one of the bigger-priced runners who shows dramatically improved form. Camshaft with cheekpieces first time could be the beneficiary.

watchPoints.text: Paradise Park could steal this if allowed to dictate at her own pace with no other natural leaders to pressure her early
Miss Kassiopi's recent winning form makes her dangerous if getting the right tactical setup from her hold-up style
Camshaft sports cheekpieces for the first time which could spark improvement from her disappointing hurdles record
The hold-up bias of this field could create traffic problems in the straight, favouring those who get first run
Several horses carry tongue ties suggesting wind issues, making the sustained test at 2m4f a potential problem

races.paceDynamic: Knead A Win and Doujadou will clash from the front, with both confirmed front-runners likely to set an honest gallop from the start. Johnny's Belle may sit handy behind the leaders, while the hold-up horses (Grand Teton, Mr Rafiki, Shuil Rocco, Karpenn) will need the pace to be strong enough to set up their late runs. The soft ground will emphasize stamina over speed, and the 2m4f trip should allow the early leaders to maintain their advantage if they can gallop others into submission. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those who can travel well in the first half, as the hold-up brigade may struggle if the pace becomes tactical.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Knead A Win and Doujadou maintain a strong gallop without burning each other out early
scenarios.body: The honest pace will string out the field and prevent the hold-up horses from getting into the race, with one of the leaders proving best at the finish. The soft ground will sap the speed from late closers who need a strong pace to be effective.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners go too hard and tire in the final furlong
scenarios.body: Johnny's Belle or Guardami Ancora can pick up the pieces from their handy positions, having saved energy while staying close enough to pounce. The 2m4f trip on soft ground will favor those who conserved effort early while remaining within striking distance.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Henderson Newcomer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Into The Blue shows significant improvement from his lightly-raced profile under Nico de Boinville
scenarios.body: The combination of Nicky Henderson's excellent record with newcomers and De Boinville's tactical nous could see this unexposed sort make a bold bid from midfield. His breeding suggests he'll handle the ground and trip, potentially catching tired leaders.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Recovery
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is strong enough to set up a sustained late charge from the back markers
scenarios.body: Grand Teton or Mr Rafiki could benefit from a truly-run race that brings their stamina into play over the final half-mile. However, they'll need everything to fall right including a collapse from the front-runners on this testing surface.

watchPoints.text: Monitor how aggressively Knead A Win and Doujadou engage early as both need to lead but risk burning each other out
Into The Blue's market support will indicate Henderson's confidence in this lightly-raced newcomer's chances
Watch for Johnny's Belle to be positioned prominently but not committed too early given her tactical speed
Grand Teton needs to overcome poor Sandown form and must be produced with a well-timed late run to be effective
Observe if any of the hold-up horses struggle to get into contention if the pace becomes moderate early

races.paceDynamic: Barford Brook and Bebe And Bean are both confirmed front-runners who will contest the early lead, ensuring an honest gallop from the start. With two dedicated pace-setters in a 13-runner field, the tempo should be solid throughout the 2m trip on soft ground. The sustained pace will test stamina reserves and expose any weaknesses in jumping technique as horses tire. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and hold-up horses who can conserve energy early and finish strongly, while the pace-setters face a tough task sustaining their effort to the line.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If both Barford Brook and Bebe And Bean tie up in the final half-mile after their early battle
scenarios.body: The honest early gallop becomes unsustainable and the race falls apart, allowing a closer to pick up the pieces. Hold-up horses with proven stamina reserves will benefit most from the collapsing pace scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Sustained Honest Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If one of the front-runners (likely Bebe And Bean) establishes a clear lead and maintains it
scenarios.body: The even tempo throughout will suit horses that can travel well in behind and have the class to respond when asked. Prominent racers with tactical speed will be perfectly positioned to strike.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Early Pace War
scenarios.trigger: If Barford Brook and Bebe And Bean engage in a prolonged speed duel through the first mile
scenarios.body: Both leaders will compromise each other's chances, setting up the race for horses positioned in the first half of the field. The frenetic early pace will find out stamina limitations and favor those held up initially.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Bebe And Bean breaks clear early while Barford Brook struggles to match the pace
scenarios.body: The more experienced bumper performer asserts superiority and controls the race from the front. Only horses with genuine class and finishing kick will be able to reel in a loose leader.

watchPoints.text: Barford Brook could cause interference if struggling early, having been pulled up on his only previous start
Bebe And Bean faces fitness concerns after 429-day absence despite retaining experienced Sean Bowen in the saddle
Laios Tresor shows pattern of fading in the finish which could be costly if pace is honest throughout
Ettore represents Nicky Henderson who excels with improving young hurdlers and showed clear progress at Taunton latest
My Boy Aaron's wind surgery appears to have unlocked improvement as evidenced by recent consistent place efforts

races.paceDynamic: Shabalko d'Herm and Meatloaf are the confirmed front-runners who will contest the early lead, with both having pace-pressing tendencies that should create an honest gallop from the start. The 2m4f trip on soft ground will test stamina reserves as these leaders stretch the field through the middle stages. El Gavilan, Thewoodcorner, Manigod and Watchful Protector will track prominently behind the pace, while the hold-up horses Fresh Speculation, Milldam and Jack's Jury will rely on the strong early pace to set up their finishing kicks. This pace scenario clearly favours the prominent trackers and hold-up horses who can capitalize on the expected early burn-up between the leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If both Shabalko d'Herm and Meatloaf go forward aggressively from the start
scenarios.body: The honest gallop stretches the field and sets up a tactical finish where horses tracking prominently can time their moves perfectly. Hold-up horses with stamina reserves get the perfect setup to unleash late rallies.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Moderate Tempo Battle
scenarios.trigger: If one of the front-runners takes a lead while the other sits second, creating controlled fractions
scenarios.body: The pace becomes more tactical with a stronger emphasis on finishing speed over the final 4-5 furlongs. Prominent runners with tactical speed hold the key positions entering the home straight.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders tire significantly after 2 miles, creating a slow-motion finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure stamina test where horses with proven course form and distance experience can grind out victories. Those who've won over similar trips in similar conditions gain decisive advantages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Shabalko d'Herm or Meatloaf gets an uncontested lead and controls fractions
scenarios.body: The leader dictates terms throughout and has enough left to resist late challenges, particularly if stepping up in trip suits. Horses sitting close behind struggle to make meaningful inroads in the straight.

races.paceDynamic: With Calli Black non-running, Boston Joe becomes the primary early leader alongside prominent runners Ezmerellda, L'Empire Vert, Ferando and Devilsrollthedice creating a bunched frontrunning group. This congestion will create a steady but competitive gallop through the middle stages, with potential traffic problems at the business end when 5 horses want similar positions. The hold-up brigade of Italian Spirit, Just Aidan, Golden Millie, Manhattan Valley, Lunar Ocean and Dublin To Milan will get a perfect setup from this pace scenario. This race shape strongly favours horses that can be held up and delivered late, as the prominent runners will compromise each other.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent group go too hard trying to establish position early
scenarios.body: The pace will collapse in the final half-mile allowing the patient hold-up horses to sweep past tired leaders. Italian Spirit, Just Aidan, Manhattan Valley and Lunar Ocean will have first run on the faltering pace-setters.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.body: One of the classier prominent runners establishes a decisive advantage before the hold-up horses can organize their challenge. Boston Joe's course form or L'Empire Vert's class could prove decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is muddling and turns into a sprint
scenarios.body: The race becomes a mad dash from 3 out with whoever has the most tactical speed winning. This suits horses like Golden Millie and Dublin To Milan who can quicken despite their hold-up style.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent group cause a wall of horses turning for home
scenarios.body: Severe interference will allow an outsider tracking wide or getting a clean run to capitalize on others' misfortune. Ferando or Devilsrollthedice could benefit from positional luck.

races.paceDynamic: Flemenstide will take the field along at a sustainable tempo from the front, with no obvious challengers for the early lead in this small field. Vision De Maine, Mythe Bridge, Montmartin, Bridget Mary and The Magus will track in a bunched group behind the leader, while Bali Body and River Run Free are likely to be held up at the rear. With only one confirmed front runner and no obvious pace pressers, this sets up as a steady-tempo affair that will develop into a sprint finish over the final half-mile. This tactical setup clearly favours prominent racers and hold-up horses who can quicken late, as they'll get the perfect target to aim at without being compromised by early pace pressure.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady throughout and Flemenstide is caught close home
scenarios.body: Vision De Maine or Mythe Bridge capitalize on their prominent positions to strike in the final furlong when the leader tires. Their superior class ratings and ability to quicken off a steady pace gives them the tactical edge.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horse Swoops
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly pedestrian and creates a sprint finish
scenarios.body: River Run Free gets the perfect setup to unleash his finishing kick from the rear, with Bali Body also benefiting if staying sound. The slow tempo allows these hold-up horses to close from impossible positions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Flemenstide Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If the leader maintains his gallop to the line without serious challenge
scenarios.body: The 11-year-old front runner proves too tough for his pursuers, capitalizing on the light weight and lack of pace pressure. His recent form suggests he's capable if getting an easy lead.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Flemenstide stops dramatically and creates chaos in running
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with horses coming from all angles, potentially suiting any runner who avoids trouble. Bridget Mary's consistent form could see her pick up the pieces.

races.paceDynamic: Les's Destiny Star stands alone as the confirmed front-runner and will set an uncontested lead through the early stages of this 3m test. With multiple prominent racers like Glengolly, Bradman, An Buachaill Rua, and Kantagua Du Large likely to track close behind, the pace will be genuine but sustainable rather than frantic. The large field of 16 runners includes many hold-up horses (Atlantic Power, Makinbecon, Cote d'Ange, Mind Hunter, Pooley's Promise, I Am Spider Man, Star Turn, Rock On Cassie, Miss Jaffa Cake) who will create a competitive finish if they can get into contention. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can secure good positions early and have the stamina to kick from the front group, as the hold-up brigade may struggle to make up ground against the large field over this extended trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Power Play
scenarios.trigger: If Les's Destiny Star sets a steady pace and the prominent runners get ideal positions behind
scenarios.body: The front group will have first run on the field turning for home, with the best-positioned prominent racer able to strike decisively. Hold-up horses will find too much traffic and ground to make up against 16 runners over 3m.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too strong early with prominent runners pressuring Les's Destiny Star
scenarios.body: The front-runners will weaken significantly in the closing stages, allowing a well-ridden hold-up horse with stamina to sweep through late. The soft ground will aid their finishing kick.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Les's Destiny Star gets an easy uncontested lead and stays on strongly
scenarios.body: The leader will have enough left in the tank to repel all challengers, particularly if given a wind operation boost. Prominent runners may track too close and weaken, while hold-up horses leave it too late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If early fractions are unsustainably fast with multiple prominent runners going too hard
scenarios.body: The entire front group will tie up badly in the final half-mile, creating chaos and allowing a patiently-ridden outsider to emerge from the pack. Form horses may disappoint completely.
